about.title: Fabrication partners for the *pharma floor.*
about.statement: Shreeyog Pharma Equipments specializes in S.S and M.S fabrication, steel metal work, and clean room furniture for pharmaceutical, chemical, and allied industries.
about.body: We design and manufacture a wide range of products including S.S tanks, S.S wall guards, staircase railings, hospital accessories, and more. With a commitment to quality and precision, we cater to the specific needs of our clients, ensuring compliance with industry standards and delivering reliable solutions for diverse industrial applications.

founder.name: Anil Shahasane
founder.bio: Anil Shahasane, the CEO and founder of Shreeyog Pharma Equipments, has accumulated more than 16 years of experience in producing customized stainless steel equipment for pharmaceutical firms. Despite his executive responsibilities, Mr. Shahasane is recognized for his hands-on approach and diverse skill set.
founder.bio2: He is directly involved in field operations, taking on roles such as welder, argon welder, fitter, buffer, and other tasks, showcasing his commitment to ensuring efficient and timely completion of projects. His leadership style is known for being democratic, as he promotes teamwork and encourages employees to thrive in their respective positions within the company.

mission.title: Vision & *mission*
mission.mission: Our goal is to create and produce top-notch stainless steel and metal items tailored to the unique requirements of pharmaceutical, chemical, and related sectors. We aim to guarantee maximum customer satisfaction through precise engineering and dependable service.
mission.vision: We aspire to become a reliable pioneer in the manufacturing sector, recognized for our creativity, superior workmanship, and dedication to surpassing customer anticipations. Furthermore, we are committed to continually improving our abilities to meet the changing needs of the industry.

projects.title: Floors and walls that *pass inspection.*
projects.body: At Shreeyog Pharma Equipments we specialize in delivering high-quality epoxy flooring and partition solutions tailored to meet the diverse needs of commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. With a strong commitment to craftsmanship, durability, and innovation, we have earned the trust of numerous companies across sectors by transforming their spaces into efficient, safe, and aesthetically pleasing environments.
projects.epoxy: We provide seamless, chemical-resistant, and easy-to-maintain epoxy flooring systems ideal for warehouses, factories, showrooms, hospitals, and more. Whether it’s for heavy-duty industrial use or a clean, polished look for commercial interiors, our epoxy work stands out for its strength and finish.
projects.partition: We offer smart and customized partitioning systems including gypsum partitions, aluminum/glass partitions, modular office cabins, and cleanroom partitions. Our solutions help optimize space, ensure privacy, and enhance workflow efficiency for offices, production areas, and institutions.

steps.title: Installation & handover
steps.text: Installed on site and handed over on schedule — with support after.
